# taba Provider

Manages the queues, distributors and access tokens of a [Taba](https://github.com/rafaelpontani/taba) cluster through its client API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    taba = {
      source = "rafaelpontani/taba"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and the token can also come from TABA_URL and TABA_TOKEN.
provider "taba" {
  endpoint = "https://taba.example.com:8080"
  token    = var.taba_token
  # ca_cert_file = "ca.pem" # a private certificate authority

  # Take over the queues, distributors and tokens that already exist (created by hand, by taba-cli or by an
  # application at startup) instead of failing. Off by default; each resource can override it.
  # create_or_update = true
}

variable "taba_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_cert_file` (String) Path of a PEM file with a private certificate authority. Conflicts with `ca_cert_pem`.
- `ca_cert_pem` (String) PEM of a private certificate authority that signs the API certificate. Conflicts with `ca_cert_file`. Default: the `TABA_CA_CERT` environment variable (a PEM or a file path).
- `create_or_update` (Boolean) Default of the `create_or_update` attribute of every resource: when creating a queue, distributor or token that already exists in the cluster, take it over (and bring it to the declared configuration) instead of failing. Off by default, because it takes over in silence what may belong to another configuration. Default: the `TABA_CREATE_OR_UPDATE` environment variable (`true` or `false`), or `false`.
- `endpoint` (String) URL of the client API (the cluster load balancer), such as `https://taba.example.com:8080`. Default: the `TABA_URL` environment variable.
- `request_timeout` (String) Timeout of each call, as a Go duration (`30s`, `1m`). Default: `30s`.
- `retry_max_wait` (String) Total wait, as a Go duration (`3m`, `90s`), between the attempts of a call that gets `429` or `503`: each one waits for the `Retry-After` (5 s from a node of the cluster) or 1, 2, 4… up to 64 seconds, and no attempt is made whose wait would pass this total. A node that crashed answers for the definitions it owns until the others vote it out (about a minute). It also bounds the creations of a token that get `503 cluster.quorum-unavailable`, each one after revoking what the previous one may have created. `0s`: no new attempt. Default: `3m`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Access token (`Authorization: Bearer`). Queues and distributors need `create` and `manage` within their prefixes; tokens need the root token (or an `admin` one for tokens that are not `admin`). Default: the `TABA_TOKEN` environment variable. Without it, the calls go without authentication.
